descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-08 Handoff Summary · S20 「故障下发送：一次失败的发送、一次重试、一次双击，和一个快两天的发件人时钟——每次正好一条记录，用服务器的时间」 Send under faults: a failed send, a retry, a double tap and a sender clock two days off — exactly one record each, with the server's time

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U11 The record's timestamp follows the server clock (3.8): a sender device with a wrong date or time zone does not change the recorded send time.（UAT 3.8；UAT TC-08） — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr
  • U6 Every sent handoff leaves a persistent record (sender, recipient, timestamp) that both the sender and the recipient can retrieve.（UAT TC-08；TFA-92586 AC 8） — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr
  • U4 The sending physician can edit the generated handoff before sending, and the recipient, retrieving it from their own account, sees exactly the edited text.（UAT TC-08；TFA-92586 AC 4） — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr
  • U5 The handoff is generated and delivered entirely in-app, only to a signed-in, valid Round Companion recipient (another physician's account), never to an arbitrary email address; …（UAT TC-08；TFA-92586 AC 6；TFA-92586 AC 7） — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr
  • U8 No email client opens, no mailto: link fires, and there is no email or external-share path for a handoff under any condition, failures included (the After-Pilot no-PHI email notification is absent to …（UAT TC-08；TFA-92586 AC 6） — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Sender and a seeded @roundai.test recipient, each in their own browser context; the sender's context runs its clock two days ahead in another time zone; S01 census

When Sender opens Handoff → Send to…, adds 'QA-EDIT-F5 failure check' to the text and picks the recipient; the runner makes the first handoffs:send fail at the Convex socket; the sender presses Send, then presses Send again; then the sender sends a second handoff with a double-click on Send; …

Then After the failed send: the dialog is still open with the edited text, no 'Sent to' label, no new Sent or Received row, and no mailto:/email/share fallback; after the retry: exactly one Received row; after the double-click: exactly one more; every record's sentAt is an ISO-8601 time inside the runner's own clock window for that send, not two days ahead; …

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Probe assertions: the editor value still contains QA-EDIT-F5 after the failure; no 'Sent to ' text; row counts 0 after the failure, 1 after the retry, +1 after the double-click (never +2); during the failure the page has no 'mailto:', 'Email', 'Share', no window.open and no navigation away; …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 FAULT · 故障注入；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（automated）

S20 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-08.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：FAULT · 故障注入；辅助：MULTI · 多端 / 多账号 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：dev。
